bukhari:2633.hi: Read all952 characters. Abu Said reports the Bedouin migration question and the complete successive camel, charity, gift and milking questions, then the conditional assurance about deeds beyond the seas. The multi-step Muhammad/Ozai/Zuhri/Ata route is context; retain coherent final Abu Said framing and all actual dialogue/conditions. The parenthetic zakat word is an explicit lexical apposition to sadaqa and provisionally belongs in retained context, without deleting either actual charity question or reply. No Bedouin identity is supplied.
bukhari:2633.ur: Read all862 characters independently. Preserve the own sequence of questions, yes replies, water-day/milking condition and final if/then assurance. Exclude the pure multi-step prefatory route, retaining final Abu Said narration. The standalone زکوٰۃ apposition is a term explanation, retained as context; no question predicate, quantity or response is lost.

bukhari:2641.hi: Read all771 characters. This is the actual Umar statement heard through Abdullah ibn Utba, contrasting past revelation with present assessment of manifest actions, trust/protection and inner accountability. It is Umar supplied judgement, not direct Prophet speech. Keep a coherent final Abdullah-heard-Umar attribution and the complete finite statement, including every exception and even-if clause; the earlier Hakam/Shuayb/Zuhri/Humayd route is pure transmission context.
bukhari:2641.ur: Read all721 characters. Own Urdu gives Abdullah ibn Utba hearing Umar, then Umar explicit first-person plural decision and reasoning. Retain the complete good/bad, outward/inward and regardless-of-claim distinctions under Umar voice. Earlier prefatory route is context; there is no appended lexical explanation in the body.

bukhari:2642.hi: Read all731 characters. Anas supplies two funeral encounters, the differing public appraisals, both obligatory replies, the actual question and the final testimony statement. Cut the earlier Sulaiman/Hammad/Thabit chain. The or-other-words/same-meaning/transmitter-doubt block is explicitly equivalent-formula apparatus rather than an additional event. Preserve the actual second criticism and resumed reply. The final parenthesis saying acceptance before God supplies a finite predicate to the testimony clause inside the quoted answer and should remain qualified source wording; do not infer any missing Paradise/Hell object.
bukhari:2642.ur: Read all659 characters. The own two-funeral dialogue is finite and complete. Earlier route and the expressly same-meaning wording-comparison/doubt block are context, while both actual appraisals/replies and question remain. The parenthetic بارگاہ الٰہی میں مقبول ہے supplies the actual predicate of the testimony clause and stays with the supplied speech, without claiming external verification of its parenthetical origin.

bukhari:2647.hi: Read all634 characters. Aisha reports the arrival, seated man, actual identity question and her milk-brother answer, then the age-limited nursing reply. The long Muhammad/Sufyan/Ashath/father/Masruq prefix and terminal corroborating-route sentence have no separate body and remain context. The opening home and milk-brother appositions are framing explanations rather than distinct acts, with the relationship supplied in her actual answer; retain them in complete context. Preserve all actual speech and the young-age condition.
bukhari:2647.ur: Read all590 characters independently. Keep Aisha own question/answer scene and the final nursing-at-young-age restriction. Pure initial route and final Muhammad/Abdur Rahman/Sufyan transmission note stay context. The home setting gloss and premature milk-brother apposition stay context; the actual brother claim remains inside Aisha reply, with no actor identity borrowed.

bukhari:2648.hi: Read all597 characters. After two prefatory routes, Urwah supplies the conquest-time theft/appearance/order event; Aisha separately reports the same unnamed woman later repentance, marriage and visits/requests. Preserve these two actual voices as ordered components in one source family, not a single direct Prophet saying. Earlier Ismail/Ibn Wahb/Yunus/Layth/Ibn Shihab chain is context; keep coherent final Urwah framing. No woman identity is supplied.
bukhari:2648.ur: Read all538 characters. Own Urdu has the parallel-route prefix followed by Urwah finite event and Aisha subsequent first-person practice. Keep the two voices distinct within the same source episode; do not turn the later visits into an unprinted Prophet quote. The unnamed woman remains unnamed and conquest timing remains exact.

bukhari:2659.hi: Read all1050 characters. Uqbah actual marriage and milk-witness encounter, repeated presentation, turning away, departure and final reply/prohibition are supplied. The two initial chains and explicit alternate told-me/I-heard wording are transmission apparatus; retain a coherent final Uqbah frame without choosing an alternate formula. The reply parentheses nikah and could-remain supply its actual subject and predicate and must stay with the rhetorical question, together with the because clause. Do not interpret the earlier juda phrase as an independently completed divorce.
bukhari:2659.ur: Read all938 characters independently. Preserve the actual marriage, unnamed woman milk testimony, repeated approaches and supplied final question/prohibition. The initial routes, second-chain label and equivalent transmission-mode comparison belong in context. The source parenthetical marriage subject and remaining-marriage predicate materially define the reply and remain; no additional actor identity or legal conclusion is supplied.

bukhari:2675.hi: Read all503 characters. The own Hindi contains an abbreviated/damaged route, Ibn Abi Awfa reported market oath episode, the supplied verse transliteration with its actual parenthetic translation, and his separately attributed assessment of deceptive price bidding. Retain verse and translation as the stated revelation subject. The Hindi duplicates mil raha tha and lacks Urdu explicit contrary/negative clause; preserve that defect without claiming the omitted false-price assertion. Preserve the damaged final assessment words literally and classify it as Ibn Abi Awfa own saying, not Prophet speech.
bukhari:2675.ur: Read all565 characters. Pure Ishaq/Yazid/Awwam transmission prefix is context, with coherent final Ibrahim-heard-Ibn Abi Awfa framing retained. The own Urdu explicitly includes the contrary-price condition, actual verse excerpt/rendering and Ibn Abi Awfa ethical assessment. Keep the last attributed judgement as its own component in the same family; it is not a mere dictionary gloss or a Prophet quotation. Do not copy Urdu missing-clause evidence into Hindi.

bukhari:2681.hi: Read all576 characters. Abu Sufyan reports Heraclius actual retrospective question and conclusion about five stated commands/Prophet characteristics. Keep Heraclius as the quoted speaker, not Prophet direct speech. Earlier multi-step chain is context; retain coherent final Abu Sufyan relay. The parenthetic Muhammad identification is explanatory reference apparatus, retained as context without replacing the source pronoun or inventing an external identity mapping.
bukhari:2681.ur: Read all501 characters. The own finite content is Heraclius reported speech to Abu Sufyan about the prior question, answer, commands and resulting characterization. Retain every actual command and attribution. Pure prefatory route and the parenthetic Muhammad name apposition are context; the report type remains historical reported speech, not an unsupplied Prophet quotation.

bukhari:2683.hi: Read all886 characters. Jabir supplies the after-Prophet-death arrival of property, Abu Bakr debt/promise announcement, then his own claim of a promise and three five-hundred payments. Preserve the temporal condition, both announcement alternatives and all repeated quantities. Earlier route and the parenthetic Bahrain-agent title are context. Keep the actual Hindi Ala bin Hazmi spelling unchanged; distinguish the announcement scene and Jabir personal claim/payment while retaining one source family.
bukhari:2683.ur: Read all782 characters. Own Urdu gives the same finite chronological scene and Jabir actual first-person claim/payment, with the printed Ala bin Hadrami name. Keep all three500 amounts and the three hand movements. The Bahrain-agent title is an identifying apposition, while the after-death circumstance is actual narrative scope. Do not harmonize the distinct Hindi name spelling or turn the embedded promise claim into a new verbatim quote.

bukhari:2685.hi: Read all958 characters. Ibn Abbas supplies an actual admonition and reasoning, not direct Prophet speech or the reviewer own assertion. Cut the pure prefatory chain. The short world/Quran/people-of-book appositions are explanatory terms or repeated references and stay context. Retain the last through-your-Prophet qualification: it defines the mode/recipient relation of the otherwise collective revealed-to-you wording. Preserve every actual question, oath, contrast and negative clause; do not import external theological wording.
bukhari:2685.ur: Read all872 characters. Preserve Ibn Abbas full attributed statement and its explicit through-your-Prophet qualification. Earlier route and world/Quran/repeated people-of-book labels are context. The people-of-book parenthesis is unclosed in the source: only the actual appositional opening/name can be context, never the following پوچھنے کو نہیں روکتا question predicate. Keep every printed word and no invented closing parenthesis.

bukhari:2693.hi: Read all497 characters. Sahl reports the Quba quarrel, thrown stones, report reaching the Prophet and actual proposal to go make peace. The long initial route is context; retain coherent final Sahl attribution and the entire finite scene. The proposal is not converted into a claim that reconciliation was completed.
bukhari:2693.ur: Read all442 characters independently. The own body supplies the quarrel/escalation, information and go-reconcile statement. Retain all actual content after the final reporter, with the earlier Muhammad/Abdulaziz/Ishaq/Muhammad/Abu Hazim route context. No actual success or participant identity is added.

bukhari:2694.hi: Read all595 characters. This is Aisha own verse interpretation, including the actual verse transliteration/rendering and the stated hypothetical marital case and mutual-consent assessment. It is an attributed Companion saying, not an excluded unvoiced compiler essay or Prophet speech. Keep the parenthetic interpretation-said bridge as it supplies the actual frame/predicate, and retain maintenance/etc as the supplied object/domain of the wife proposal. Pure initial route is context; no locator label or external verse number is supplied.
bukhari:2694.ur: Read all565 characters. The own Urdu gives Aisha attributed exegesis with the actual quoted verse and rendering as its subject, not a new recitation event. Preserve the تفسير میں فرمایا bridge, the wife proposal maintenance-domain parenthesis, all age/dislike/separation conditions and both-parties consent. Earlier Qutaybah/Sufyan/Hisham/father route is transmission context; nothing is repaired from Hindi.

bukhari:2698.hi: Read all1082 characters. Bara supplies the treaty/document wording, objection, Ali refusal, erasure and visit/weapon conditions. The earlier Muhammad/Ghundar/Shubah/Abu Ishaq route is context. The Quraysh apposition is a party-identification gloss; the next-year parenthesis is material temporal scope and stays. The final students question/answer explicitly defines the technical weapon-container term, so that lexical appendix stays complete context, not an extra registered event. Preserve both the document quotation and all actual dialogue without external reconstruction.
bukhari:2698.ur: Read all969 characters independently. Keep the actual treaty negotiation, quoted titles, Ali refusal, erasure and next-year/three-day/sheathed-weapons conditions. Earlier chain, Quraysh identification apposition and the terminal lexical-definition dialogue are context. Do not let the final technical term explanation absorb the preceding actual weapon condition or delete the temporal qualifier.

bukhari:2700.hi: Read all1040 characters. Bara reports all three actual treaty conditions and Abu Jandal chained arrival/return. Earlier route is context. The1/2/3 parenthetic labels are structural enumeration apparatus, with all three actual conditions and the body count retained. Keep the finite converted-and-imprisoned circumstance because it supplies the arriving person status, and the according-to-treaty qualification because it limits the return action. Final Bukhari variant-omission and equivalent weapon-term wording note is transmission context, not a separate supplied body.
bukhari:2700.ur: Read all945 characters. Independently preserve the two directions of the first condition, next-year/only-three-days condition, weapon condition and actual Abu Jandal episode. Retain the conversion/imprisonment and according-to-treaty parentheticals as substantive source circumstances. The three enumeration labels alone may stay context; the final Muammal omission and term comparison is compiler transmission apparatus. No missing variant body is invented.

ibnmajah:2612.hi: Read all571 characters. Ashath supplies the Kinda delegation encounter, his status in it, the lineage question and actual reply. A transmitter then separately reports Ashath habitual conditional saying about someone denying a Qurashi lineage. Keep that later Companion statement distinct from the original encounter and Prophet reply, under Ashath actual voice rather than Prophetic attribution. The conditional threatened action is not reported as already carried out. All source words and names remain exact.
ibnmajah:2612.ur: Read all516 characters independently. The own Urdu contains a finite delegation report and a separate later used-to-say conditional Ashath judgement. Preserve the source superiority assessment and both negatives in the reply. Do not collapse the later statement into Prophet speech, infer an actual punishment, or import genealogy beyond the supplied words.

ibnmajah:2622.hi: Read all2030 characters in full. Abu Said explicitly testifies to hearing/remembering the supplied99-then100 killings/repentance narrative. Preserve wrongful-killing qualifiers, the first respondent actual interjection and question predicates, the sinful-settlement circumstance, every mercy/judgement/Iblis clause and all actual numbers. Hammam/Humayd/Bakr is a route, followed by a finite source-named Abu Rafi adjudicating-angel addition; keep that supplied addition distinctly attributed, without inventing its ultimate speaker. Qatadah then relays Hasan Basri finite approaching-death movement/outcome addition, not Hasan eyewitness testimony. Both additions concern this same supplied story family. Retain their actual when-dispute trigger, adjudication purpose and measure-distance imperative; these are finite source qualifications, not lexical substitutions.
ibnmajah:2622.ur: Read all1979 characters in full independently. The initial Abu Said hearing testimony introduces the complete99/100 repentance story. Retain every actual condition and utterance, including parenthetical wrongful-action qualifications, respondent question predicates, the sinful-village relation and the Urdu-only mercy-deserving conclusion in the reported angels response; do not supply it to Hindi. The Hammam/Humayd/Bakr prefatory route is context, but Abu Rafi actual adjudication addition and Qatadah/Hasan actual near-death movement version remain separately typed transmitted components in the same family, with no unsupplied ultimate speaker or eyewitness status. Their temporal/purpose and measure-distance clauses remain literal. Only the two Urdu footnote markers are apparatus within these bodies.

ibnmajah:2633.hi: Read all154 characters. Mughira supplies the finite attributed decision that diya is upon aqila. The parenthetic قاتل-family rendering is a technical-term definition, retained in context; the actual term and judgement remain selected. The own Hindi gloss names the killer family, whereas Urdu additionally names the killer, so preserve each original definition without harmonization or an external legal ruling.
ibnmajah:2633.ur: Read all138 characters. The own Urdu finite decision is attributed through Mughira. Aqila explanatory parenthesis says the killer and his family; retain that exact potentially differing glossary in context, not as a repaired version of Hindi. The main judgement and its original term stay literal and no modern legal recommendation is derived.

ibnmajah:2636.hi: Read all457 characters. Jariyah reports a sword injury with the explicit not-at-the-joint limitation, complaint, diya decision, injured person qisas request and reply/prayer, then explicit no-qisas conclusion. Preserve every physical qualifier, request and negative outcome; no participant identity or broader rule is inserted. All finite source content can remain.
ibnmajah:2636.ur: Read all416 characters. Independently preserve the complete injury/complaint/request/reply narrative, especially لیکن جوڑ پر سے نہیں and the terminal negative decision. The blood-money rendering ( خون بہا ) is a lexical gloss after دیت and stays context; the actual diya words, blessing and refusal remain selected.

ibnmajah:2640.hi: Read all453 characters. Miswar reports Umar consultation, Mughira explicit witness statement citing the slave-or-slave-woman decision, Umar demand for testimony and Muhammad ibn Maslamah supporting testimony. Preserve all actual voices and the disjunction; the cited historical decision is not a new universal rule invented by the reviewer. Keep the consultation, embedded witness statement and resumed request/testimony distinguishable within one source episode.
ibnmajah:2640.ur: Read all391 characters. The own Urdu finite consultation contains the same explicitly attributed Mughira witness statement and the subsequent actual witness request/support. Retain the supplied people, disjunction and whole dialogue with no missing legal details added. Only the terminal۱؎ marker is source apparatus; all claimed voices come from this field itself.

ibnmajah:2641.hi: Read all491 characters. Ibn Abbas supplies Umar search for a ruling, then Hamal ibn Malik actual standing testimony about his two wives and two deaths, with the reported decisions. Separate the consultation frame from Hamal own account in the same family, rather than attributing all speech to the Prophet. Both janin parenthetical translations are lexical context; retain the actual pregnancy relation and slave-or-slave-woman disjunction and the separately supplied woman-for-woman clause without legal expansion.
ibnmajah:2641.ur: Read all446 characters. The own Urdu gives the finite Ibn Abbas/Umar setting and Hamal testimony, including both deaths and the two reported decisions. Keep all participant relations, numbers and alternatives. The two slightly different پیٹ کے بچے/بچہ renderings are term glosses, and the terminal۱؎ is apparatus; complete literal context is preserved.

ibnmajah:2647.hi: Read all355 characters. Abdullah ibn Amr transmits the actual attributed statement concerning liability, residual inheritance and the alternative if the woman is killed. Preserve the only-remaining-share limit, the if clause and all stated agencies. The father-relatives parenthesis is a definition of asabah and remains context; the technical term itself and whole actual statement remain exact. No modern ruling or unstated relationship is added.
ibnmajah:2647.ur: Read all334 characters. Independently retain the complete attributed statement with the residual-share restriction, conditional death case and specified heirs/agents. The parenthetic definition of عصبہ is lexical apparatus only; do not turn it into a new actor list or change the actual source term.

ibnmajah:2648.hi: Read all252 characters. Jabir supplies an abbreviated/damaged liability event, a stated inheritance claim and an actual final inheritance reply naming husband and son. Preserve the Hindi katilah/maqtulah words and defective joins including the stranded wasallam fragment, without restoring omitted attribution or full honorific from Urdu. The father-relatives parenthesis is a lexical asabah gloss and stays context. The actual finite reply is eligible with its damaged bridge visibly qualified, not fabricated from the intact sibling.
ibnmajah:2648.ur: Read all254 characters. Own Urdu supplies the liability event, the printed مقتولہ relatives inheritance claim and the explicitly attributed reply to husband/son. Preserve all original party labels even if the legal sequence appears unusual; no harmonization with external versions or Hindi repairs. The asabah parenthetical definition alone is lexical context.
